title: Letters to Father Betański, partly in cipher: some solved between the lines, some not
correspondents: unknown; Bouden (1757), perhaps Betański → J. K. Branicki (1771)
status: Catalogue: nos. 135-142 'z interlinearnem rozwiązaniem', 129 'szyfr rozwiązany', 132 'z rozwiązaniem szyfru'; 131 'nierozszyfrowany', 143 'częściowo szyfr nierozwiązany'.
why: Interlinear siblings give a key directly, which may read the unsolved letters and the Branicki family ciphers.
score_note: Scored from the archive description during the Nov 2026 Chrome pass (research/chrome_pass_2026-11/); not viewed
verify: Rebuild the key from the interlinear letters and apply it to 128, 130, 131, 143.
prior_art: open as far as checked (2 Nov 2026: known.py; one web search on the correspondents found nothing on this cipher; Tomokiyo, Lasry, edition not searched)
access_note: scans public on szukajwarchiwach.gov.pl, no login
vetting_note: Seen 2 Nov 2026: 128 and 130 are pure letter cipher with no solution on the page (130 after clear French); 131 (11 July 1757) is clear Polish, then numbers and letters; the 143 page seen is clear French. Solved 135 (8 Feb 1766) is 3-digit numbers with French between the lines. Held back: mixed systems in one row, and the numeric letters are key-lookup candidates. The cover of 128 has a faint pencil note that may read rozwiązany. Prior art per lead: research/chrome_pass_2026-11/prior_a.json, prior_b.json, prior_c.json.
earlier_note: needs Chrome: https://www.szukajwarchiwach.gov.pl/jednostka/-/jednostka/28223835 (also 28223837, 28223838, 28223850); scans are a JS viewer. Mixed systems; 128 cover pencil note may read 'rozwiazany'; siblings 129,132-142 have interlinear solutions, so prior decipherment of 128/130/131/143 must be checked leaf by leaf (known.py: only lead rows)
